name: Fighter
text: Fighting for honor, greed, loyalty, or simply the thrill of battle, you are an undisputed master of weaponry and combat techniques.

features.name: Reactive Strike
features.text: Reaction. Trigger: a creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to it.

features.name: Shield Block
features.text: General feat (granted). Reaction. Trigger: while you have your shield raised, you would take physical damage from an attack. Your shield prevents damage up to its Hardness; you and the shield each take any remaining damage.

suggested_build.description: dm.ai suggested build (app-authored; anchored on the published class kit and key attribute): a classic sword-and-board human fighter. Candidate lists are ordered; the planner takes the first legal pick(s) against the folded draft, so lists run longer than needed.

features.name: Bravery
features.text: Having faced countless foes and the chaos of battle, you have learned how to stand strong in the face of fear. Your proficiency rank for Will saves increases to expert. When you roll a success at a Will save against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Wizard
text: You are an eternal student of the secrets of the universe, treating magic like a science and casting powerful arcane spells learned through rigorous study.

features.name: Arcane Spellcasting
features.text: You cast spells of the arcane tradition using the Cast a Spell activity. At 1st level you can prepare two 1st-rank spells and five cantrips each morning from your spellbook, plus one extra curriculum cantrip and one extra curriculum spell of each rank you can cast from your arcane school.

features.name: Arcane Thesis
features.text: During your studies you produced a thesis of unique magical research; you gain a special benefit depending on its topic.

features.name: Arcane School
features.text: You choose the arcane school where you learned your magic; it grants a school spell (a focus spell you cast with your pool of 1 Focus Point) and extra curriculum spells and slots.

features.name: Arcane Bond
features.text: You place some of your magical power in a bonded item, designated each day during preparations; you gain the Drain Bonded Item free action to recover an expended spell once per day.

features.name: Spellbook
features.text: Your spellbook contains your choice of 10 arcane cantrips and five 1st-rank arcane spells, plus two more 1st-rank spells added from your school's curriculum.
